settings.repere: Intertitre · How Do I Use It?
settings.text: How Do I Use It?

settings.repere: Texte · Morning: Apply a small amount of the D…
settings.text: Morning: Apply a small amount of the Day Balm.

settings.repere: Texte · Night: Apply a small amount of the Nig…
settings.text: Night: Apply a small amount of the Night Balm before bed.

settings.repere: Texte · 2 to 3 times a week: With dry hands, p…
settings.text: 2 to 3 times a week: With dry hands, pour a pinch of scrub powder into your palm before you get in the shower. Mix with water and scrub your face for 1 to 2 minutes.

settings.repere: Texte · These formulas contain 0% water, so th…
settings.text: These formulas contain 0% water, so they are extremely concentrated. You need much less than a standard lotion. For faster results, spot apply the Night Balm to active pimples 3 to 4 times a day.

settings.repere: Texte · Keep the scrub jar dry and outside the…
settings.text: Keep the scrub jar dry and outside the shower. It is a pure powder with no preservatives, so water inside the jar can cause mold.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What Results Can I Expect?
settings.text: What Results Can I Expect?

settings.repere: Texte · Many people notice changes after one n…
settings.text: Many people notice changes after one night: less visible redness and calmer, clearer-looking skin.

settings.repere: Texte · In our 60-day clinical study, a dermat…
settings.text: In our 60-day clinical study, a dermatologist rated 80% of participants as showing improvement in acne appearance.

settings.repere: Texte · 93% of customers say this is the best …
settings.text: 93% of customers say this is the best product they have tried.

settings.repere: Texte · True results take time. Give your skin…
settings.text: True results take time. Give your skin 30 to 60 days for the best long-term results.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Will I Experience Purging Or Side Effe…
settings.text: Will I Experience Purging Or Side Effects?

settings.repere: Texte · Some people notice a brief adjustment …
settings.text: Some people notice a brief adjustment period in the first 1 to 2 weeks as their skin adapts to the concentrated formula. Existing congestion may surface before it settles. This is normal and typically resolves within 2 to 3 weeks.

settings.repere: Texte · If anything feels off beyond 2 weeks, …
settings.text: If anything feels off beyond 2 weeks, stop use and check with your healthcare provider.

settings.text: Can Women Use This?

settings.repere: Texte · Absolutely. Our Arctic plant formula w…
settings.text: Absolutely. Our Arctic plant formula works on human skin. Thousands of women and teens use Norse daily.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Can Teens Use This?
settings.text: Can Teens Use This?

settings.repere: Texte · Yes, and it is a smart choice for them…
settings.text: Yes, and it is a smart choice for them. Teens are already going through major hormonal changes. The last thing they need is skincare full of harsh synthetic ingredients. Norse is 100% natural.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What Skin Types Does It Work On?
settings.text: What Skin Types Does It Work On?

settings.repere: Texte · Every type. Our formula was built for …
settings.text: Every type. Our formula was built for the extremes of Norway, from −30°C to +30°C. It works on oily, dry, sensitive, and combination skin, on all skin tones, and with any facial hair.

settings.repere: Texte · It contains no alcohol, synthetic frag…
settings.text: It contains no alcohol, synthetic fragrances, parabens, or sulfates. Cold-pressed thistle oil, the base of both balms, is non-comedogenic and hydrates without increasing oil production.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What Type Of Acne Is It Made For?
settings.text: What Type Of Acne Is It Made For?

settings.repere: Texte · Made for all acne-prone skin: adult, t…
settings.text: Made for all acne-prone skin: adult, teen, mild, recurring, and on the back, chest, and shoulders.

settings.repere: Texte · You do not need frequent breakouts to …
settings.text: You do not need frequent breakouts to benefit. Many people start for mild or occasional breakouts and find it keeps their skin looking consistently clear.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Can I Use It On Body Acne?
settings.text: Can I Use It On Body Acne?

settings.repere: Texte · Yes. It is made for your back, chest, …
settings.text: Yes. It is made for your back, chest, and shoulders too. Because it is natural and gentle, you can use it anywhere you break out.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What About Acne Marks And Scars?
settings.text: What About Acne Marks And Scars?

settings.repere: Texte · The key to preventing marks is fast he…
settings.text: The key to preventing marks is fast healing. The Night Balm contains a high concentration of marigold (calendula), a classic soothing botanical that helps soften the look of marks. In the end, you’ll have a calmer skin, less visible marks.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What About Makeup?
settings.text: What About Makeup?

settings.repere: Texte · We recommend minimizing it. Heavy make…
settings.text: We recommend minimizing it. Heavy makeup can clog pores and slow healing. To remove it, avoid harsh cleansers. Use the Day Balm or even extra virgin olive oil. Both dissolve makeup without damaging your barrier.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What Happens After 60 Days?
settings.text: What Happens After 60 Days?

settings.repere: Texte · Most people see their biggest change b…
settings.text: Most people see their biggest change between day 30 and day 60. The ritual supports balanced, comfortable skin, so consistency is what keeps it looking clear long term.

settings.repere: Texte · For post-acne marks after the first 60…
settings.text: For post-acne marks after the first 60 days, The Complete System For Acne-Prone Skin 2.0 adds a targeted step.

settings.repere: Texte · Not happy within 60 days? You get a fu…
settings.text: Not happy within 60 days? You get a full refund.
